title: Teaser from Lore & Legends Maker — 3 years of trying to build a non-scripted world
author: tschilpi
selftext:
Hey guys! I'm excited to share a gameplay teaser from the Lore & Legends Maker. This is a project I have been working on for more than 3 years. What started as a simple desire to be able to play Dungeons & Dragons with an AI Dungeon Master turned into an entire world model.

Basically, I've kept iterating on this because my wish was to realize this feeling of being an adventurer who can freely interact in the world, with non scripted game behavior. So I built a game engine over the last 3 years (yes, before you could even code with AI properly) which slowly evolved into a world model. 

How it works: You can give as input an adventure module like a real Dnd Adventure such as e.g. Curse of Strahd, or your own written notes. The World Model builds canonical world lore, and from it canon storylines. It then produces an adventure module with NPCs, factions, scenes and interactions. It tries to precisely model everything, such as informational asymmetry, beliefs, what each faction and NPC wants etc. 

The underlying system is a simulation system I built as a Entity Component System. It's basically what Google Deepmind proposes for building an Generative AI based Game Engine ([paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.08892))

So the world has a spatial model, camera perspectives, NPCs are not state machines but instead modelled with a mix of Goal oriented action planning and simulative behavior (also see the Concordia paper on modelling social agents). Meaning they have their own goals and plans and will act according to them in the world.

It's still in a early alpha and the above is the new patch which will be released sometime later this month. 

In the gameplay clip, a player creates his wizard character by choosing his cantrips. He is then thrown into a prison by sneaky goblins where he must find a way to escape. It has roll tables, etc. and its modelled like a runtime for a TTRPG. After he escapes his cell he encounters a rat nest, attacks it, and after killing one of the rats, it turns out it was the friend of an Ogre who goes on to attack the player to take revenge.
